senses.definition: vb. weigh, balance (‖ form of סָלָא q.v.);—
Impf. 3 fs. לֹא־תְסֻלֶּה בְּכֶתֶם Jb 28:16 it cannot be weighed against (estimated in) gold of Ophir, cf. v 19.
